info.title: Grade & Condition System API
info.description: Mode C API of the Grade & Condition System (SSPS v1): tiers on items, variants and graded units, the tier showcase, listing filters, warranty per tier, mapping to external condition vocabularies and per-unit inspections with photos and shareable reports. Website keys: pk_ for public reads from the bound domain, sk_ for everything else. Standard resources (/v1/entitlement, /v1/config, /v1/events, /v1/strings) as in every SSPS product.

get.summary: The tier ladder of the website, best first (pk_: shown tiers; sk_: also hidden ones with `active`).
One tier.
Tiers of items: `ids=a,b` (≤ 100) for badges on listings, else every graded item by id with cursor pagination.
The tier of an item (catalog item or your own external id), of its variants and every tier it is offered in.
Assignments by item and variant. sk_ only.

post.summary: Set the tier of an item (no variantId) or of one variant — an upsert: 201 when new, 200 when changed or unchanged. Publishes grades.tier_assigned@1 on a change. sk_ only.
Up to 100 assignments with per-item results. sk_ only.

get.summary: One assignment. sk_ only.

delete.summary: Remove an assignment (publishes grades.tier_assigned@1 with tier null). sk_ only.

get.summary: Individually graded units (serials, lots, rooms…), newest first. sk_ only.

post.summary: Register a graded unit of an item (a catalog item or your own external id), optionally with its tier and a unique serial. Retries with the same Idempotency-Key return the first result. sk_ only.

get.summary: One unit. sk_ only.

patch.summary: Change tier, note, serial or availability (JSON Merge Patch). sk_ only.

delete.summary: Remove a unit (soft: kept with its inspections, out of listings; its report link stops working). sk_ only.

post.summary: A new shareable report link for an inspected unit (replaces the previous one). Only the token hash is stored. sk_ only.

delete.summary: Revoke the unit’s report link. sk_ only.

get.summary: The tier explainer: every shown tier, one tier, or the tiers of one item, with copy, media and the warranty period.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Only the tiers of this item

get.summary: Tier filter options of a listing (one collection or the whole catalog) with counts.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Collection id from the catalog events

get.summary: Item ids offered in any of the selected tiers (`tier=a,b`), optionally in one collection, by id.

post.summary: Order item ids by tier (best first, worst first or as given) (a pure computation).

get.summary: Warranty terms of every shown tier; `format=text` returns printable plain text.

items.label: Excellent
items.text: 6 months warranty on items graded Excellent.

get.summary: Warranty terms of one tier.

example.label: Good
example.text: 3 months warranty on items graded Good.

get.summary: The mapping table: every vocabulary with its value per tier (sk_ also gets the mapping problems).
An item’s conditions in every vocabulary — item level, per variant and per offered tier — with the structured-data properties to merge into Offer nodes.
Feed rows (item, variant, tier and the vocabulary’s value under its property name) of every assignment, by item. sk_ only.
Inspection checklists of the website. sk_ only.
One checklist. sk_ only.
Inspections, newest first. sk_ only.

post.summary: Start an inspection of a unit with the named or first matching checklist; with `complete: true` it completes at once (required answers and photos present), scores it, suggests a tier, grades the unit and publishes grades.unit_inspected@1. sk_ only.

get.summary: One inspection with its photos. sk_ only.

patch.summary: Add or change results of a draft; `complete: true` completes it (an explicit `tier` overrides the suggestion). sk_ only.

post.summary: A presigned upload slot in the merchant’s bucket for one photo of a checklist item. Content-Type and Content-Length are signed headers: PUT exactly the returned headers and a body of exactly `size` bytes. sk_ only.

get.summary: The buyer-facing report behind a report token: tier, score, checklist answers and photos (presigned view links).
Dashboard counts (SSO session).

post.summary: Re-grade a unit from the dashboard (SSO session, audited).
Create a unit’s report link from the dashboard (SSO session, audited).
Diagnostics of a rules@1 condition (applies_when, visible_when, checklist conditions).

get.summary: The dashboard session (launch kind, role, scope).

post.summary: Dashboard "Clean up stale photos": delete this website's inspection photo slots past their stale date (the object in the merchant’s bucket, then the slot), at most 100 per call. The same clean-up runs on the website's next photo upload; nothing runs on a timer.

websiteKey.description: pk_ (browser, domain-locked) or sk_ (server) website key

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional. Units, inspections and photo slots: a retry with the same key returns the record made first.

Lang.name: lang
Lang.description: BCP 47 language of texts (default: the website’s)

serial.description: Unique per website (serial number, lot, room number…)
